# Page structure: home

## Page goal

Primary keyword: same day plumber harbor city

Conversion action: book a same-day plumber visit online

Traffic source and temperature: Google search and map listings, hot

## Section 2 decision

Lead with: social proof

Why: hot traffic from local search with a simple offer gets proof first (research/01-goal-offer.md).

## Section plan

| # | Section | Its one job | Content comes from | Proof used | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero | Land the same-day fixed-price outcome and get the booking | 01, 02, 05 | Proof 1 and 2 | Book a same-day visit |
| 2 | Social proof | Show neighbors got fixed the same day | 02, 04 | Proof 3 | none |
| 3 | Proof | Prove one-visit fixes with numbers | 04 | 92 percent one-visit | none |
| 4 | Feature 1: Fixed price | Show the price is agreed before any work | F1 | Proof 1, quote-sheet.jpg | Book a same-day visit |
| 5 | Feature 2: Photo upload | Show the plumber arrives ready | F2 | none | none |
| 6 | Feature 3: Arrival text | Show there is no waiting at home all day | F3 | none (gap: arrival review) | none |
| 7 | Feature 4: 12-month warranty | Show a failed fix costs nothing | F4 | Warranty terms | Book a same-day visit |
| 8 | How it works | Make booking feel easy | 05 plan | none | none |
| 9 | FAQ and FUD reducers | Answer price, timing, trust and mess fears | 02 objections | Proof 1 | none |
| 10 | Closer | Repeat the outcome and ask for the booking | 01, 05 | Proof 2 | Book a same-day visit |

## Feature definitions

| # | Feature | What it does (input, action, result) | How it works (mechanism, 2 to 4 specifics) | Pain it removes (02-customers.md) | Benefit (the so-what) | Proof or hard specific (04-proof.md) | Visual that demonstrates it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | Fixed price before work | The plumber inspects, writes a fixed price, and starts only after you agree | Price written on a quote sheet; work starts on your yes; 89 USD call-out fee comes off the bill if you go ahead | Fear of a surprise bill | You know the cost before you commit | Proof 1, assets/quote-sheet.jpg | Filled quote sheet, details blurred |
| F2 | Photo upload at booking | You add a photo of the problem when you book; the plumber sees it before leaving | Optional field in the booking form; plumber checks it before driving out | A second visit to fetch a part | The right part arrives with the plumber | 92 percent one-visit rate (supporting) | Booking form with the photo field filled |
| F3 | Arrival window by text | You get a text with a time window instead of an all-day slot | Text within 15 minutes of booking; a new text if the window changes | Waiting at home all day for a no-show | You can plan your day around the visit | none, gap recorded (arrival review) | Phone showing the arrival text |
| F4 | 12-month labor warranty | If the same fault returns within 12 months, the labor to fix it again is free | Covers every repair; same fault, 12 months, labor free; in the terms of service | Paying twice for a fix that fails | A failed fix costs you nothing | 04-proof.md guarantees | Warranty line on the job receipt |
